subject: Re: DevSummit 2026 — trade proposal for stage slot vs. paid package
messages:
From: Sasha Reynolds <sasha@devsummit.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: sponsorships@devsummit.io
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 12:12:00 -0700
Subject: DevSummit 2026 — Redwood Spotlight package and booth options

Hi Mina,

Great to connect last week. Attaching the Spotlight package (DevSummit_Spotlight_Package_v3.pdf) for your review — it includes a 20-minute spotlight stage session, prominent large-format logo on the main sponsor banner, a 10x10 premium island booth near the entrance, and a lead-gen email to our registered attendee list (opt-in allowed).

Typical price for this is $35k + AV. We can also add a sponsored breakout if you want more technical depth; that's a separate add-on.

Do you have flexibility on budget, or would Redwood prefer an in-kind trade? A common lean-in we offer is to trade a reduced cash fee for a guaranteed keynote/introduction or priority booth placement. If you can share the attendee profile you most want to target, I can propose a tailored visibility plan.

Attachments: DevSummit_Spotlight_Package_v3.pdf, devsummit_exhibit_map_v2.png

Best,
Sasha Reynolds
Partnerships Manager, DevSummit
sasha@devsummit.io | +1 415-555-0192

Hi Sasha,

Thanks — reviewed the PDF. Two quick asks from our side:

1) Instead of paying full list price, we can consider a partial trade: Redwood will take the 15–20 min Spotlight stage session (ideally the 2nd day morning slot) in exchange for a reduced cash fee and guaranteed "priority exchange": larger logo (2x on the main hero banner) + premium booth placement within the first 3 rows from the main entrance.

2) We need confirmation that the lead-gen email will be a Redwood-branded send (you provide the blast to your list but allow us one dedicated HTML send) and that registrant opt-in language complies with our privacy team.

If you can provisionally hold a morning Spotlight slot and send an updated package showing the priority-exchange economics, I can loop in Marissa (Events Ops) and Ben (Field Marketing) for quick approval. Also please send the exhibitor footprint with booth neighbors (we care about adjacent competitors).

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com | +1 212-555-0104

From: Sasha Reynolds <sasha@devsummit.io>

Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DevSummit 2026 — Redwood Spotlight package and booth options

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the clear ask. I ran this by the sponsorship ops team — we can tentatively hold a 15-minute morning Spotlight slot (Day 2, 9:45–10:00) in exchange for a reduced cash fee ($18k) if Redwood agrees to the following visibility upgrades:

- Large-format logo (2x exposure) on the main sponsor banner and on the mobile app hero placement
- Dedicated lead-gen email to registrants (we send; Redwood supplies HTML and manages consent copy)
- Prime booth position (10x10 island) near Entrance A

We cannot guarantee a keynote intro (chair-controlled) but will request the conference chair to introduce the Spotlight — we can include that ask in the contract as "best-effort". I attached an updated package reflecting the priority-exchange numbers.

If that works, I'll draft an exhibitor addendum and route for signature (DocuSign link). Also happy to jump on a 15m call to finalize language for the lead-gen opt-in.

Attachments: DevSummit_Spotlight_Package_v3.pdf (updated)

Regards,
Sasha Reynolds
Partnerships Manager, DevSummit
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:50:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: DevSummit 2026 — priority-exchange proposal (need quick sign-off)

Marissa / Ben — forwarding the update from DevSummit. Key points: tentatively held 15-min morning Spotlight (Day 2, 09:45) for reduced fee ($18k) if we accept the priority-exchange (2x logo, mobile app hero, dedicated lead-gen send, prime island booth).

Questions for you:
- Are we comfortable with a 15-min Spotlight vs. a full 20-min (trade-off seems small)?
- Budget cap: $18k cash + in-kind trade okay?
- Contract asks: request explicit AV credit (we'll cover presenter travel), and add language that the chair intro is "best-effort" but request a clause for promotional placement if intro denied.

I've attached the updated package and the exhibit map. If you approve, Sasha will send a DocuSign for an exhibitor addendum to sign. I can take the call to finalize lead-gen consent copy.

Attachments: DevSummit_Spotlight_Package_v3.pdf, devsummit_exhibit_map_v2.png

Thanks, Mina
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: DevSummit 2026 — priority-exchange proposal (need quick sign-off)

Thanks for the ping.

I support the stage-for-visibility trade. A few add-ons to push for in the addendum before signing:
- One complimentary speaker AV tech run-through and 30-min early access to the stage for slide checks
- Two comp exhibitor passes and one additional expo-only pass for partner outreach
- A requirement that the lead-gen email is pre-approved by us (copy + opt-in language) and that any data transfer is strictly 1st-party consented registrants only.

Ben — any objection?

Ben Carter: "Agree — also request the chair does a short intro. If chair intro not possible, insist on a 30-second sponsor pre-roll video insertion before the Spotlight slot."

Marissa Cole
Senior Events Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
